variable.description: The configuration for a variable reward value (e.g. points per dollar spent). Only present when type is `variable`, otherwise this key will be omitted from response.

action_text.description: A short call-to-action style text, appropriate for use in buttons or links, guiding the customer on how to use the reward fulfillment. This field may be blank

action_url.description: A URL destination guiding the customer on how to use the reward, often paired with the `action_text` for use in buttons or links. This field may be blank.

code.description: A unique code for the customer to use or apply the reward fulfillment. This is commonly a discount code the customer applies at checkout on their next order, but it can be a unique code they use for other purposes like accessing an exc

created_at.description: The date and time when the reward fulfillment was created.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer that the reward fulfillment belongs to.

expires_at.description: The date and time when the reward fulfillment expires. When the reward is a discount code, this refers to the expiry date of the discount, and a `null` value indicates that the discount code does not expire.

fulfillment_status.description: The fulfillment status of the reward fulfillment, indicating whether the reward is available to the customer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the reward fulfillment.

image_url.description: An image for the reward fulfillment.

name.description: The name of the reward fulfillment.

terms_and_conditions.description: A description of the reward fulfillment's limitations or restrictions. When the reward is a discount code, this commonly includes expiry date, minimum order amounts, or applicability to specific product collections.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the reward fulfillment was last updated.

usage_instructions.description: A description of how the customer can use or apply the reward fulfillment.

usage_status.description: The usage status of the reward fulfillment, indicating whether the generated reward has been used by the customer.

used_at.description: The date and time when the reward fulfillment was used by the customer. If the reward fulfillments does not support usage tracking, this field may be `null` even after the reward fulfillment has been used.

entry_rewards.description: A set of nested Reward objects representing the rewards that are issued to a customer when they enter the VIP tier.

image_url.description: The image of the VIP tier.

milestone.description: The threshold that a customer must reach to be eligible for the VIP tier. Represents either an amount of points or a dollar amount, depending on the loyalty program's configuration.

name.description: The display name of the VIP tier.

perks.description: A set of nested objects representing the ongoing benefits a customer is entitled to when they are in the VIP tier.

smile_io_customer_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a customer changes in Smile.io. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
